videos.label: m04-opener.ar.mp4
videos.summary: The video aligns well with narration and presents accurate scientific figures, but violates footage constraints by displaying a clear frontal presenter face.

findings.note: Identifiable frontal face shown in footage segments (00:01–00:07 and 01:12–01:41), violating blueprint § 3 which permits people in footage only without an identifiable face (from behind, over-the-shoulder, distant, or soft focus).
